units.leftText: On the first day of the second month of the second year after the Israelites had come out of the land of Egypt, the LORD spoke to Moses in the Tent of Meeting in the Wilderness of Sinai. He said:
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the tent of meeting, on the first day of the second month, in the second year after they were come out of the land of Egypt, saying,

units.leftText: “Take a census of the whole congregation of Israel by their clans and families, listing every man by name, one by one.
units.rightText: Take ye the sum of all the congregation of the children of Israel, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, every male, by their polls;

units.leftText: You and Aaron are to number those who are twenty years of age or older by their divisions— everyone who can serve in Israel’s army.
units.rightText: from twenty years old and upward, all that are able to go forth to war in Israel, thou and Aaron shall number them by their hosts.

units.leftText: And one man from each tribe, the head of each family, must be there with you. The Leaders of the Tribes
units.rightText: And with you there shall be a man of every tribe; every one head of his fathers’ house.

units.leftText: These are the names of the men who are to assist you: From the tribe of Reuben, Elizur son of Shedeur;
units.rightText: And these are the names of the men that shall stand with you. Of Reuben: Elizur the son of Shedeur.

units.leftText: from Simeon, Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai;
units.rightText: Of Simeon: Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

units.leftText: from Judah, Nahshon son of Amminadab;
units.rightText: Of Judah: Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

units.leftText: from Issachar, Nethanel son of Zuar;
units.rightText: Of Issachar: Nethanel the son of Zuar.

units.leftText: from Zebulun, Eliab son of Helon;
units.rightText: Of Zebulun: Eliab the son of Helon.

units.leftText: from the sons of Joseph: from Ephraim, Elishama son of Ammihud, and from Manasseh, Gamaliel son of Pedahzur;
units.rightText: Of the children of Joseph: Of Ephraim: Elishama the son of Ammihud. Of Manasseh: Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

units.leftText: from Benjamin, Abidan son of Gideoni;
units.rightText: Of Benjamin: Abidan the son of Gideoni.

units.leftText: from Dan, Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai;
units.rightText: Of Dan: Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

units.leftText: from Asher, Pagiel son of Ocran;
units.rightText: Of Asher: Pagiel the son of Ochran.

units.leftText: from Gad, Eliasaph son of Deuel;
units.rightText: Of Gad: Eliasaph the son of Deuel.

units.leftText: and from Naphtali, Ahira son of Enan.”
units.rightText: Of Naphtali: Ahira the son of Enan.

units.leftText: These men were appointed from the congregation; they were the leaders of the tribes of their fathers, the heads of the clans of Israel. The Number of Every Tribe
units.rightText: These are they that were called of the congregation, the princes of the tribes of their fathers; they were the heads of the thousands of Israel.

units.leftText: So Moses and Aaron took these men who had been designated by name,
units.rightText: And Moses and Aaron took these men that are mentioned by name:

units.leftText: and on the first day of the second month they assembled the whole congregation and recorded their ancestry by clans and families, counting one by one the names of those twenty years of age or older,
units.rightText: and they assembled all the congregation together on the first day of the second month; and they declared their pedigrees after their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, by their polls.

units.leftText: just as the LORD had commanded Moses. So Moses numbered them in the Wilderness of Sinai:
units.rightText: As Jehovah commanded Moses, so he numbered them in the wilderness of Sinai.

units.leftText: From the sons of Reuben, the firstborn of Israel, according to the records of their clans and families, counting one by one the names of every male twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army,
units.rightText: And the children of Reuben, Israel’s first-born, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, by their polls, every male from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

units.leftText: those registered to the tribe of Reuben numbered 46,500.
units.rightText: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Reuben, were forty and six thousand and five hundred.

units.leftText: From the sons of Simeon, according to the records of their clans and families, counting one by one the names of every male twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army,
units.rightText: Of the children of Simeon, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, those that were numbered thereof, according to the number of the names, by their polls, every male from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

units.leftText: those registered to the tribe of Simeon numbered 59,300.
units.rightText: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Simeon, were fifty and nine thousand and three hundred.

units.leftText: From the sons of Gad, according to the records of their clans and families, counting the names of all those twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army,
units.rightText: Of the children of Gad, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

units.leftText: those registered to the tribe of Gad numbered 45,650.
units.rightText: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Gad, were forty and five thousand six hundred and fifty.

units.leftText: From the sons of Judah, according to the records of their clans and families, counting the names of all those twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army,
units.rightText: Of the children of Judah, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

units.leftText: those registered to the tribe of Judah numbered 74,600.
units.rightText: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Judah, were threescore and fourteen thousand and six hundred.

units.leftText: From the sons of Issachar, according to the records of their clans and families, counting the names of all those twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army,
units.rightText: Of the children of Issachar, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

units.leftText: those registered to the tribe of Issachar numbered 54,400.
units.rightText: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Issachar, were fifty and four thousand and four hundred.

units.leftText: From the sons of Zebulun, according to the records of their clans and families, counting the names of all those twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army,
units.rightText: Of the children of Zebulun, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

units.leftText: those registered to the tribe of Zebulun numbered 57,400.
units.rightText: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Zebulun, were fifty and seven thousand and four hundred.

units.leftText: From the sons of Joseph:
units.rightText: Of the children of Joseph, namely, of the children of Ephraim, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

units.leftText: those registered to the tribe of Ephraim numbered 40,500.
units.rightText: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Ephraim, were forty thousand and five hundred.

units.leftText: And from the sons of Manasseh, according to the records of their clans and families, counting the names of all those twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army,
units.rightText: Of the children of Manasseh, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

units.leftText: those registered to the tribe of Manasseh numbered 32,200.
units.rightText: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Manasseh, were thirty and two thousand and two hundred.

units.leftText: From the sons of Benjamin, according to the records of their clans and families, counting the names of all those twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army,
units.rightText: Of the children of Benjamin, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

units.leftText: those registered to the tribe of Benjamin numbered 35,400.
units.rightText: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Benjamin, were thirty and five thousand and four hundred.

units.leftText: From the sons of Dan, according to the records of their clans and families, counting the names of all those twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army,
units.rightText: Of the children of Dan, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

units.leftText: those registered to the tribe of Dan numbered 62,700.
units.rightText: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Dan, were threescore and two thousand and seven hundred.

units.leftText: From the sons of Asher, according to the records of their clans and families, counting the names of all those twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army,
units.rightText: Of the children of Asher, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

units.leftText: those registered to the tribe of Asher numbered 41,500.
units.rightText: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Asher, were forty and one thousand and five hundred.

units.leftText: From the sons of Naphtali, according to the records of their clans and families, counting the names of all those twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army,
units.rightText: Of the children of Naphtali, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

units.leftText: those registered to the tribe of Naphtali numbered 53,400.
units.rightText: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Naphtali, were fifty and three thousand and four hundred.

units.leftText: These were the men numbered by Moses and Aaron, with the assistance of the twelve leaders of Israel, each one representing his family.
units.rightText: These are they that were numbered, whom Moses and Aaron numbered, and the princes of Israel, being twelve men: they were each one for his fathers’ house.

units.leftText: So all the Israelites twenty years of age or older who could serve in Israel’s army were counted according to their families.
units.rightText: So all they that were numbered of the children of Israel by their fathers’ houses, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war in Israel;

units.leftText: And all those counted totaled 603,550. The Exemption of the Levites
units.rightText: even all they that were numbered were six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.

units.leftText: The Levites, however, were not numbered along with them by the tribe of their fathers.
units.rightText: But the Levites after the tribe of their fathers were not numbered among them.

units.leftText: For the LORD had said to Moses:
units.rightText: For Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “Do not number the tribe of Levi in the census with the other Israelites.
units.rightText: Only the tribe of Levi thou shalt not number, neither shalt thou take the sum of them among the children of Israel;

units.leftText: Instead, you are to appoint the Levites over the tabernacle of the Testimony, all its furnishings, and everything in it. They shall carry the tabernacle and all its articles, care for it, and camp around it.
units.rightText: but appoint thou the Levites over the tabernacle of the testimony, and over all the furniture thereof, and over all that belongeth to it: they shall bear the tabernacle, and all the furniture thereof; and they shall minister unto it, and shall encamp round about the tabernacle.

units.leftText: Whenever the tabernacle is to move, the Levites are to take it down, and whenever it is to be pitched, the Levites are to set it up. Any outsider who goes near it must be put to death.
units.rightText: And when the tabernacle setteth forward, the Levites shall take it down; and when the tabernacle is to be pitched, the Levites shall set it up: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.

units.leftText: The Israelites are to camp by their divisions, each man in his own camp and under his own standard.
units.rightText: And the children of Israel shall pitch their tents, every man by his own camp, and every man by his own standard, according to their hosts.

units.leftText: But the Levites are to camp around the tabernacle of the Testimony and watch over it, so that no wrath will fall on the congregation of Israel. So the Levites are responsible for the tabernacle of the Testimony.”
units.rightText: But the Levites shall encamp round about the tabernacle of the testimony, that there be no wrath upon the congregation of the children of Israel: and the Levites shall keep the charge of the tabernacle of the testimony.

units.leftText: Thus the Israelites did everything just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
units.rightText: Thus did the children of Israel; according to all that Jehovah commanded Moses, so did they.

units.leftText: Then the LORD said to Moses and Aaron:
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

units.leftText: “The Israelites are to camp around the Tent of Meeting at a distance from it, each man under his standard, with the banners of his family.
units.rightText: The children of Israel shall encamp every man by his own standard, with the ensigns of their fathers’ houses: over against the tent of meeting shall they encamp round about.

units.leftText: On the east side, toward the sunrise, the divisions of Judah are to camp under their standard:
units.rightText: And those that encamp on the east side toward the sunrising shall be they of the standard of the camp of Judah, according to their hosts: and the prince of the children of Judah shall be Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

units.leftText: and his division numbers 74,600.
units.rightText: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were threescore and fourteen thousand and six hundred.

units.leftText: The tribe of Issachar will camp next to it. The leader of the Issacharites is Nethanel son of Zuar,
units.rightText: And those that encamp next unto him shall be the tribe of Issachar: and the prince of the children of Issachar shall be Nethanel the son of Zuar.

units.leftText: and his division numbers 54,400.
units.rightText: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, were fifty and four thousand and four hundred.

units.leftText: Next will be the tribe of Zebulun. The leader of the Zebulunites is Eliab son of Helon,
units.rightText: And the tribe of Zebulun: and the prince of the children of Zebulun shall be Eliab the son of Helon.

units.leftText: and his division numbers 57,400.
units.rightText: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, were fifty and seven thousand and four hundred.

units.leftText: The total number of men in the divisions of the camp of Judah is 186,400; they shall set out first.
units.rightText: All that were numbered of the camp of Judah were a hundred thousand and fourscore thousand and six thousand and four hundred, according to their hosts. They shall set forth first.

units.leftText: On the south side, the divisions of Reuben are to camp under their standard:
units.rightText: On the south side shall be the standard of the camp of Reuben according to their hosts: and the prince of the children of Reuben shall be Elizur the son of Shedeur.

units.leftText: and his division numbers 46,500.
units.rightText: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, were forty and six thousand and five hundred.

units.leftText: The tribe of Simeon will camp next to it. The leader of the Simeonites is Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai,
units.rightText: And those that encamp next unto him shall be the tribe of Simeon: and the prince of the children of Simeon shall be Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

units.leftText: and his division numbers 59,300.
units.rightText: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were fifty and nine thousand and three hundred.

units.leftText: Next will be the tribe of Gad. The leader of the Gadites is Eliasaph son of Deuel,
units.rightText: And the tribe of Gad: and the prince of the children of Gad shall be Eliasaph the son of Reuel.
leftNotes: 2:14 Many MT manuscripts, SP, and Vulgate (see also Numbers 1:14|NUM 1:14*); most MT manuscripts Reuel

units.leftText: and his division numbers 45,650.
units.rightText: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were forty and five thousand and six hundred and fifty.

units.leftText: The total number of men in the divisions of the camp of Reuben is 151,450; they shall set out second.
units.rightText: All that were numbered of the camp of Reuben were a hundred thousand and fifty and one thousand and four hundred and fifty, according to their hosts. And they shall set forth second.

units.leftText: In the middle of the camps, the Tent of Meeting is to travel with the camp of the Levites. They are to set out in the order they encamped, each in his own place under his standard.
units.rightText: Then the tent of meeting shall set forward, with the camp of the Levites in the midst of the camps: as they encamp, so shall they set forward, every man in his place, by their standards.

units.leftText: On the west side, the divisions of Ephraim are to camp under their standard:
units.rightText: On the west side shall be the standard of the camp of Ephraim according to their hosts: and the prince of the children of Ephraim shall be Elishama the son of Ammihud.

units.leftText: and his division numbers 40,500.
units.rightText: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were forty thousand and five hundred.

units.leftText: The tribe of Manasseh will be next to it. The leader of the Manassites is Gamaliel son of Pedahzur,
units.rightText: And next unto him shall be the tribe of Manasseh: and the prince of the children of Manasseh shall be Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

units.leftText: and his division numbers 32,200.
units.rightText: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were thirty and two thousand and two hundred.

units.leftText: Next will be the tribe of Benjamin. The leader of the Benjamites is Abidan son of Gideoni,
units.rightText: And the tribe of Benjamin: and the prince of the children of Benjamin shall be Abidan the son of Gideoni.

units.leftText: and his division numbers 35,400.
units.rightText: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were thirty and five thousand and four hundred.

units.leftText: The total number of men in the divisions of the camp of Ephraim is 108,100; they shall set out third.
units.rightText: All that were numbered of the camp of Ephraim were a hundred thousand and eight thousand and a hundred, according to their hosts. And they shall set forth third.

units.leftText: On the north side, the divisions of Dan are to camp under their standard:
units.rightText: On the north side shall be the standard of the camp of Dan according to their hosts: and the prince of the children of Dan shall be Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

units.leftText: and his division numbers 62,700.
units.rightText: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were threescore and two thousand and seven hundred.

units.leftText: The tribe of Asher will camp next to it. The leader of the Asherites is Pagiel son of Ocran,
units.rightText: And those that encamp next unto him shall be the tribe of Asher: and the prince of the children of Asher shall be Pagiel the son of Ochran.

units.leftText: and his division numbers 41,500.
units.rightText: And his hosts, and those that were numbered of them, were forty and one thousand and five hundred.

units.leftText: Next will be the tribe of Naphtali. The leader of the Naphtalites is Ahira son of Enan,
units.rightText: And the tribe of Naphtali: and the prince of the children of Naphtali shall be Ahira the son of Enan.

units.leftText: and his division numbers 53,400.
units.rightText: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were fifty and three thousand and four hundred.

units.leftText: The total number of men in the camp of Dan is 157,600; they shall set out last, under their standards.”
units.rightText: All that were numbered of the camp of Dan were a hundred thousand and fifty and seven thousand and six hundred. They shall set forth hindmost by their standards.

units.leftText: These are the Israelites, numbered according to their families. The total of those counted in the camps, by their divisions, was 603,550.
units.rightText: These are they that were numbered of the children of Israel by their fathers’ houses: all that were numbered of the camps according to their hosts were six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.

units.leftText: But the Levites were not counted among the other Israelites, as the LORD had commanded Moses.
units.rightText: But the Levites were not numbered among the children of Israel; as Jehovah commanded Moses.

units.leftText: So the Israelites did everything the LORD commanded Moses; they camped under their standards in this way and set out in the same way, each man with his clan and his family.
units.rightText: Thus did the children of Israel; according to all that Jehovah commanded Moses, so they encamped by their standards, and so they set forward, every one by their families, according to their fathers’ houses.

units.leftText: This is the account of Aaron and Moses at the time the LORD spoke with Moses on Mount Sinai.
units.rightText: Now these are the generations of Aaron and Moses in the day that Jehovah spake with Moses in mount Sinai.

units.leftText: These are the names of the sons of Aaron: Nadab the firstborn, then Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
units.rightText: And these are the names of the sons of Aaron: Nadab the first-born, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

units.leftText: These were Aaron’s sons, the anointed priests, who were ordained to serve as priests.
units.rightText: These are the names of the sons of Aaron, the priests that were anointed, whom he consecrated to minister in the priest’s office.

units.leftText: Nadab and Abihu, however, died in the presence of the LORD when they offered unauthorized fire before the LORD in the Wilderness of Sinai. And since they had no sons, only Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests during the lifetime of their father Aaron. The Duties of the Levites
units.rightText: And Nadab and Abihu died before Jehovah, when they offered strange fire before Jehovah, in the wilderness of Sinai, and they had no children; and Eleazar and Ithamar ministered in the priest’s office in the presence of Aaron their father.
leftNotes: 3:4 Or strange

units.leftText: Then the LORD said to Moses,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “Bring the tribe of Levi and present them to Aaron the priest to assist him.
units.rightText: Bring the tribe of Levi near, and set them before Aaron the priest, that they may minister unto him.

units.leftText: They are to perform duties for him and for the whole congregation before the Tent of Meeting, attending to the service of the tabernacle.
units.rightText: And they shall keep his charge, and the charge of the whole congregation before the tent of meeting, to do the service of the tabernacle.

units.leftText: They shall take care of all the furnishings of the Tent of Meeting and fulfill obligations for the Israelites by attending to the service of the tabernacle.
units.rightText: And they shall keep all the furniture of the tent of meeting, and the charge of the children of Israel, to do the service of the tabernacle.

units.leftText: Assign the Levites to Aaron and his sons; they have been given exclusively to him from among the Israelites.
units.rightText: And thou shalt give the Levites unto Aaron and to his sons: they are wholly given unto him on the behalf of the children of Israel.
leftNotes: 3:9 Most MT manuscripts; some MT manuscripts, SP, and LXX (see also Numbers 8:16|NUM 8:16*) to Me

units.leftText: So you shall appoint Aaron and his sons to carry out the duties of the priesthood; but any outsider who approaches the tabernacle must be put to death.”
units.rightText: And thou shalt appoint Aaron and his sons, and they shall keep their priesthood: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.

units.leftText: Again the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “Behold, I have taken the Levites from among the children of Israel in place of every firstborn Israelite from the womb. The Levites belong to Me,
units.rightText: And I, behold, I have taken the Levites from among the children of Israel instead of all the first-born that openeth the womb among the children of Israel; and the Levites shall be mine:

units.leftText: for all the firstborn are Mine. On the day I struck down every firstborn in the land of Egypt, I consecrated to Myself all the firstborn in Israel, both man and beast. They are Mine; I am the LORD.” The Numbering of the Levites
units.rightText: for all the first-born are mine; on the day that I smote all the first-born in the land of Egypt I hallowed unto me all the first-born in Israel, both man and beast; mine they shall be: I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: Then the LORD spoke to Moses in the Wilderness of Sinai, saying,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying,

units.leftText: “Number the Levites by their families and clans. You are to count every male a month old or more.”
units.rightText: Number the children of Levi by their fathers’ houses, by their families: every male from a month old and upward shalt thou number them.

units.leftText: So Moses numbered them according to the word of the LORD, as he had been commanded.
units.rightText: And Moses numbered them according to the word of Jehovah, as he was commanded.

units.leftText: These were the sons of Levi by name: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
units.rightText: And these were the sons of Levi by their names: Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari.

units.leftText: These were the names of the sons of Gershon by their clans: Libni and Shimei.
units.rightText: And these are the names of the sons of Gershon by their families: Libni and Shimei.

units.leftText: The sons of Kohath by their clans were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
units.rightText: And the sons of Kohath by their families: Amram, and Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

units.leftText: And the sons of Merari by their clans were Mahli and Mushi. These were the clans of the Levites, according to their families. The Gershonites (Numbers 4:21–28|NUM 4:21-28*; 1 Chronicles 23:7–11|1CH 23:7-11*)
units.rightText: And the sons of Merari by their families: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their fathers’ houses.

units.leftText: From Gershon came the Libnite clan and the Shimeite clan; these were the Gershonite clans.
units.rightText: Of Gershon was the family of the Libnites, and the family of the Shimeites: these are the families of the Gershonites.

units.leftText: The number of all the males a month old or more was 7,500.
units.rightText: Those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, even those that were numbered of them were seven thousand and five hundred.

units.leftText: The Gershonite clans were to camp on the west, behind the tabernacle,
units.rightText: The families of the Gershonites shall encamp behind the tabernacle westward.

units.leftText: and the leader of the families of the Gershonites was Eliasaph son of Lael.
units.rightText: And the prince of the fathers’ house of the Gershonites shall be Eliasaph the son of Lael.

units.leftText: The duties of the Gershonites at the Tent of Meeting were the tabernacle and tent, its covering, the curtain for the entrance to the Tent of Meeting,
units.rightText: And the charge of the sons of Gershon in the tent of meeting shall be the tabernacle, and the Tent, the covering thereof, and the screen for the door of the tent of meeting,

units.leftText: the curtains of the courtyard, the curtain for the entrance to the courtyard that surrounds the tabernacle and altar, and the cords— all the service for these items. The Kohathites (Numbers 4:1–20|NUM 4:1-20*; 1 Chronicles 23:12–20|1CH 23:12-20*)
units.rightText: and the hangings of the court, and the screen for the door of the court, which is by the tabernacle, and by the altar round about, and the cords of it for all the service thereof.

units.leftText: From Kohath came the clans of the Amramites, the Izharites, the Hebronites, and the Uzzielites; these were the clans of the Kohathites.
units.rightText: And of Kohath was the family of the Amramites, and the family of the Izharites, and the family of the Hebronites, and the family of the Uzzielites: these are the families of the Kohathites.

units.leftText: The number of all the males a month old or more was 8,600. They were responsible for the duties of the sanctuary.
units.rightText: According to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, there were eight thousand and six hundred, keeping the charge of the sanctuary.
leftNotes: 3:28 Hebrew; some LXX manuscripts 8,300; see the total in verse 39.

units.leftText: The clans of the Kohathites were to camp on the south side of the tabernacle,
units.rightText: The families of the sons of Kohath shall encamp on the side of the tabernacle southward.

units.leftText: and the leader of the families of the Kohathites was Elizaphan son of Uzziel.
units.rightText: And the prince of the fathers’ house of the families of the Kohathites shall be Elizaphan the son of Uzziel.
leftNotes: 3:30 Elizaphan is a variant of Elzaphan; see Exodus 6:22|EXO 6:22* and Leviticus 10:4.

units.leftText: Their duties were the ark, the table, the lampstand, the altars, the articles of the sanctuary used with them, and the curtain— all the service for these items.
units.rightText: And their charge shall be the ark, and the table, and the candlestick, and the altars, and the vessels of the sanctuary wherewith they minister, and the screen, and all the service thereof.

units.leftText: The chief of the leaders of the Levites was Eleazar son of Aaron the priest; he oversaw those responsible for the duties of the sanctuary. The Merarites (Numbers 4:29–33|NUM 4:29-33*; 1 Chronicles 23:21–23|1CH 23:21-23*)
units.rightText: And Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be prince of the princes of the Levites, and have the oversight of them that keep the charge of the sanctuary.

units.leftText: From Merari came the clans of the Mahlites and Mushites; these were the Merarite clans.
units.rightText: Of Merari was the family of the Mahlites, and the family of the Mushites: these are the families of Merari.

units.leftText: The number of all the males a month old or more was 6,200.
units.rightText: And those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, were six thousand and two hundred.

units.leftText: The leader of the families of the Merarites was Zuriel son of Abihail; they were to camp on the north side of the tabernacle.
units.rightText: And the prince of the fathers’ house of the families of Merari was Zuriel the son of Abihail: they shall encamp on the side of the tabernacle northward.

units.leftText: The duties assigned to the sons of Merari were the tabernacle’s frames, crossbars, posts, bases, and all its equipment— all the service for these items,
units.rightText: And the appointed charge of the sons of Merari shall be the boards of the tabernacle, and the bars thereof, and the pillars thereof, and the sockets thereof, and all the instruments thereof, and all the service thereof,

units.leftText: as well as the posts of the surrounding courtyard with their bases, tent pegs, and ropes. Moses and Aaron
units.rightText: and the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords.

units.leftText: Moses, Aaron, and Aaron’s sons were to camp to the east of the tabernacle, toward the sunrise, before the Tent of Meeting. They were to perform the duties of the sanctuary as a service on behalf of the Israelites; but any outsider who approached the sanctuary was to be put to death.
units.rightText: And those that encamp before the tabernacle eastward, before the tent of meeting toward the sunrising, shall be Moses, and Aaron and his sons, keeping the charge of the sanctuary for the charge of the children of Israel; and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.

units.leftText: The total number of Levites that Moses and Aaron counted by their clans at the LORD’s command, including all the males a month old or more, was 22,000. The Redemption of the Firstborn
units.rightText: All that were numbered of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron numbered at the commandment of Jehovah, by their families, all the males from a month old and upward, were twenty and two thousand.

units.leftText: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Number every firstborn male of the Israelites a month old or more, and list their names.
units.rightText: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Number all the first-born males of the children of Israel from a month old and upward, and take the number of their names.

units.leftText: You are to take the Levites for Me— I am the LORD— in place of all the firstborn of Israel, and the livestock of the Levites in place of all the firstborn of the livestock of the Israelites.”
units.rightText: And thou shalt take the Levites for me (I am Jehovah) instead of all the first-born among the children of Israel; and the cattle of the Levites instead of all the firstlings among the cattle of the children of Israel.

units.leftText: So Moses numbered all the firstborn of the Israelites, as the LORD had commanded him.
units.rightText: And Moses numbered, as Jehovah commanded him, all the first-born among the children of Israel.

units.leftText: The total number of the firstborn males a month old or more, listed by name, was 22,273.
units.rightText: And all the first-born males according to the number of names, from a month old and upward, of those that were numbered of them, were twenty and two thousand two hundred and threescore and thirteen.

units.leftText: Again the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “Take the Levites in place of all the firstborn of Israel, and the livestock of the Levites in place of their livestock. The Levites belong to Me; I am the LORD.
units.rightText: Take the Levites instead of all the first-born among the children of Israel, and the cattle of the Levites instead of their cattle; and the Levites shall be mine: I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: To redeem the 273 firstborn Israelites who outnumber the Levites,
units.rightText: And for the redemption of the two hundred and threescore and thirteen of the first-born of the children of Israel, that are over and above the number of the Levites,

units.leftText: you are to collect five shekels for each one, according to the sanctuary shekel of twenty gerahs.
units.rightText: thou shalt take five shekels apiece by the poll; after the shekel of the sanctuary shalt thou take them (the shekel is twenty gerahs):
leftNotes: 3:47 5 shekels is approximately 2 ounces or 57 grams.
3:47 20 gerahs is equivalent to one shekel (approximately 0.4 ounces or 11.4 grams).

units.leftText: Give the money to Aaron and his sons as the redemption price for the excess among the Israelites.”
units.rightText: and thou shalt give the money, wherewith the odd number of them is redeemed, unto Aaron and to his sons.

units.leftText: So Moses collected the redemption money from those in excess of the number redeemed by the Levites.
units.rightText: And Moses took the redemption-money from them that were over and above them that were redeemed by the Levites;

units.leftText: He collected the money from the firstborn of the Israelites: 1,365 shekels, according to the sanctuary shekel.
units.rightText: from the first-born of the children of Israel took he the money, a thousand three hundred and threescore and five shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:
leftNotes: 3:50 1,365 shekels is approximately 34.3 pounds or 15.6 kilograms.

units.leftText: And Moses gave the redemption money to Aaron and his sons in obedience to the word of the LORD, just as the LORD had commanded him.
units.rightText: and Moses gave the redemption-money unto Aaron and to his sons, according to the word of Jehovah, as Jehovah commanded Moses.

units.leftText: Then the LORD said to Moses and Aaron,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

units.leftText: “Take a census of the Kohathites among the Levites by their clans and families,
units.rightText: Take the sum of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, by their families, by their fathers’ houses,

units.leftText: men from thirty to fifty years old— everyone who is qualified to serve in the work at the Tent of Meeting.
units.rightText: from thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old, all that enter upon the service, to do the work in the tent of meeting.

units.leftText: This service of the Kohathites at the Tent of Meeting regards the most holy things.
units.rightText: This is the service of the sons of Kohath in the tent of meeting, about the most holy things:

units.leftText: Whenever the camp sets out, Aaron and his sons are to go in, take down the veil of the curtain, and cover the ark of the Testimony with it.
units.rightText: when the camp setteth forward, Aaron shall go in, and his sons, and they shall take down the veil of the screen, and cover the ark of the testimony with it,
leftNotes: 4:5 That is, the ark of the covenant

units.leftText: They are to place over this a covering of fine leather, spread a solid blue cloth over it, and insert its poles.
units.rightText: and shall put thereon a covering of sealskin, and shall spread over it a cloth all of blue, and shall put in the staves thereof.
leftNotes: 4:6 Possibly the hides of large aquatic mammals; also in verses 8, 10, 11, 12, 14, and 25; see Exodus 25:5|EXO 25:5*.

units.leftText: Over the table of the Presence they are to spread a blue cloth and place the plates and cups on it, along with the bowls and pitchers for the drink offering. The regular bread offering is to remain on it.
units.rightText: And upon the table of showbread they shall spread a cloth of blue, and put thereon the dishes, and the spoons, and the bowls and the cups wherewith to pour out; and the continual bread shall be thereon:

units.leftText: And they shall spread a scarlet cloth over them, cover them with fine leather, and insert the poles.
units.rightText: and they shall spread upon them a cloth of scarlet, and cover the same with a covering of sealskin, and shall put in the staves thereof.

units.leftText: They are to take a blue cloth and cover the lampstand used for light, together with its lamps, wick trimmers, and trays, as well as the jars of oil with which to supply it.
units.rightText: And they shall take a cloth of blue, and cover the candlestick of the light, and its lamps, and its snuffers, and its snuffdishes, and all the oil vessels thereof, wherewith they minister unto it:

units.leftText: Then they shall wrap it and all its utensils inside a covering of fine leather and put it on the carrying frame.
units.rightText: and they shall put it and all the vessels thereof within a covering of sealskin, and shall put it upon the frame.

units.leftText: Over the gold altar they are to spread a blue cloth, cover it with fine leather, and insert the poles.
units.rightText: And upon the golden altar they shall spread a cloth of blue, and cover it with a covering of sealskin, and shall put in the staves thereof:

units.leftText: They are to take all the utensils for serving in the sanctuary, place them in a blue cloth, cover them with fine leather, and put them on the carrying frame.
units.rightText: and they shall take all the vessels of ministry, wherewith they minister in the sanctuary, and put them in a cloth of blue, and cover them with a covering of sealskin, and shall put them on the frame.

units.leftText: Then they shall remove the ashes from the bronze altar, spread a purple cloth over it,
units.rightText: And they shall take away the ashes from the altar, and spread a purple cloth thereon:

units.leftText: and place on it all the vessels used to serve there: the firepans, meat forks, shovels, and sprinkling bowls— all the equipment of the altar. They are to spread over it a covering of fine leather and insert the poles.
units.rightText: and they shall put upon it all the vessels thereof, wherewith they minister about it, the firepans, the flesh-hooks, and the shovels, and the basins, all the vessels of the altar; and they shall spread upon it a covering of sealskin, and put in the staves thereof.

units.leftText: When Aaron and his sons have finished covering the holy objects and all their equipment, as soon as the camp is ready to move, the Kohathites shall come and do the carrying. But they must not touch the holy objects, or they will die. These are the transportation duties of the Kohathites regarding the Tent of Meeting.
units.rightText: And when Aaron and his sons have made an end of covering the sanctuary, and all the furniture of the sanctuary, as the camp is set forward; after that, the sons of Kohath shall come to bear it: but they shall not touch the sanctuary, lest they die. These things are the burden of the sons of Kohath in the tent of meeting.

units.leftText: Eleazar son of Aaron the priest shall oversee the oil for the light, the fragrant incense, the daily grain offering, and the anointing oil. He has oversight of the entire tabernacle and everything in it, including the holy objects and their utensils.”
units.rightText: And the charge of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be the oil for the light, and the sweet incense, and the continual meal-offering, and the anointing oil, the charge of all the tabernacle, and of all that therein is, the sanctuary, and the furniture thereof.

units.leftText: Then the LORD said to Moses and Aaron,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

units.leftText: “Do not allow the Kohathite tribal clans to be cut off from among the Levites.
units.rightText: Cut ye not off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites;

units.leftText: In order that they may live and not die when they come near the most holy things, do this for them: Aaron and his sons are to go in and assign each man his task and what he is to carry.
units.rightText: but thus do unto them, that they may live, and not die, when they approach unto the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall go in, and appoint them every one to his service and to his burden;

units.leftText: But the Kohathites are not to go in and look at the holy objects, even for a moment, or they will die.” The Duties of the Gershonites (Numbers 3:21–26|NUM 3:21-26*; 1 Chronicles 23:7–11|1CH 23:7-11*)
units.rightText: but they shall not go in to see the sanctuary even for a moment, lest they die.

units.leftText: And the LORD said to Moses,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “Take a census of the Gershonites as well, by their families and clans,
units.rightText: Take the sum of the sons of Gershon also, by their fathers’ houses, by their families;

units.leftText: from thirty to fifty years old, counting everyone who comes to serve in the work at the Tent of Meeting.
units.rightText: from thirty years old and upward until fifty years old shalt thou number them; all that enter in to wait upon the service, to do the work in the tent of meeting.

units.leftText: This is the service of the Gershonite clans regarding work and transport:
units.rightText: This is the service of the families of the Gershonites, in serving and in bearing burdens:

units.leftText: They are to carry the curtains of the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting with the covering of fine leather over it, the curtains for the entrance to the Tent of Meeting,
units.rightText: they shall bear the curtains of the tabernacle, and the tent of meeting, its covering, and the covering of sealskin that is above upon it, and the screen for the door of the tent of meeting,

units.leftText: the curtains of the courtyard, and the curtains for the entrance at the gate of the courtyard that surrounds the tabernacle and altar, along with their ropes and all the equipment for their service. The Gershonites will do all that needs to be done with these items.
units.rightText: and the hangings of the court, and the screen for the door of the gate of the court, which is by the tabernacle and by the altar round about, and their cords, and all the instruments of their service, and whatsoever shall be done with them: therein shall they serve.

units.leftText: All the service of the Gershonites — all their transport duties and other work — is to be done at the direction of Aaron and his sons; you are to assign to them all that they are responsible to carry.
units.rightText: At the commandment of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonites, in all their burden, and in all their service; and ye shall appoint unto them in charge all their burden.

units.leftText: This is the service of the Gershonite clans at the Tent of Meeting, and their duties shall be under the direction of Ithamar son of Aaron the priest. The Duties of the Merarites (Numbers 3:33–37|NUM 3:33-37*; 1 Chronicles 23:21–23|1CH 23:21-23*)
units.rightText: This is the service of the families of the sons of the Gershonites in the tent of meeting: and their charge shall be under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

units.leftText: As for the sons of Merari, you are to number them by their clans and families,
units.rightText: As for the sons of Merari, thou shalt number them by their families, by their fathers’ houses;

units.leftText: from thirty to fifty years old, counting everyone who comes to serve in the work of the Tent of Meeting.
units.rightText: from thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old shalt thou number them, every one that entereth upon the service, to do the work of the tent of meeting.

units.leftText: This is the duty for all their service at the Tent of Meeting: to carry the frames of the tabernacle with its crossbars, posts, and bases,
units.rightText: And this is the charge of their burden, according to all their service in the tent of meeting: the boards of the tabernacle, and the bars thereof, and the pillars thereof, and the sockets thereof,

units.leftText: and the posts of the surrounding courtyard with their bases, tent pegs, and ropes, including all their equipment and everything related to their use. You shall assign by name the items that they are responsible to carry.
units.rightText: and the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords, with all their instruments, and with all their service: and by name ye shall appoint the instruments of the charge of their burden.

units.leftText: This is the service of the Merarite clans according to all their work at the Tent of Meeting, under the direction of Ithamar son of Aaron the priest.” The Numbering of the Levite Clans
units.rightText: This is the service of the families of the sons of Merari, according to all their service, in the tent of meeting, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

units.leftText: So Moses, Aaron, and the leaders of the congregation numbered the Kohathites by their clans and families,
units.rightText: And Moses and Aaron and the princes of the congregation numbered the sons of the Kohathites by their families, and by their fathers’ houses,

units.leftText: everyone from thirty to fifty years old who came to serve in the work at the Tent of Meeting.
units.rightText: from thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entered upon the service, for work in the tent of meeting:

units.leftText: And those numbered by their clans totaled 2,750.
units.rightText: and those that were numbered of them by their families were two thousand seven hundred and fifty.

units.leftText: These were counted from the Kohathite clans, everyone who could serve at the Tent of Meeting. Moses and Aaron numbered them according to the command of the LORD through Moses.
units.rightText: These are they that were numbered of the families of the Kohathites, all that did serve in the tent of meeting, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the commandment of Jehovah by Moses.

units.leftText: Then the Gershonites were numbered by their clans and families,
units.rightText: And those that were numbered of the sons of Gershon, their families, and by their fathers’ houses,

units.leftText: everyone from thirty to fifty years old who came to serve in the work at the Tent of Meeting.
units.rightText: from thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entered upon the service, for work in the tent of meeting,

units.leftText: And those numbered by their clans and families totaled 2,630.
units.rightText: even those that were numbered of them, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, were two thousand and six hundred and thirty.

units.leftText: These were counted from the Gershonite clans who served at the Tent of Meeting, whom Moses and Aaron counted at the LORD’s command.
units.rightText: These are they that were numbered of the families of the sons of Gershon, all that did serve in the tent of meeting, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the commandment of Jehovah.

units.leftText: And the Merarites were numbered by their clans and families,
units.rightText: And those that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, by their families, by their fathers’ houses,

units.leftText: everyone from thirty to fifty years old who came to serve in the work at the Tent of Meeting.
units.rightText: from thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entered upon the service, for work in the tent of meeting,

units.leftText: The men registered by their clans numbered 3,200.
units.rightText: even those that were numbered of them by their families, were three thousand and two hundred.

units.leftText: These were counted from the Merarite clans, whom Moses and Aaron numbered at the LORD’s command through Moses.
units.rightText: These are they that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the commandment of Jehovah by Moses.

units.leftText: So Moses, Aaron, and the leaders of Israel numbered by their clans and families all the Levites
units.rightText: All those that were numbered of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron and the princes of Israel numbered, by their families, and by their fathers’ houses,

units.leftText: from thirty to fifty years old who came to do the work of serving and carrying the Tent of Meeting.
units.rightText: from thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entered in to do the work of service, and the work of bearing burdens in the tent of meeting,

units.leftText: And the number of men was 8,580.
units.rightText: even those that were numbered of them, were eight thousand and five hundred and fourscore.

units.leftText: At the LORD’s command through Moses they were numbered, and each one was assigned his work and burden, as the LORD had commanded Moses.
units.rightText: According to the commandment of Jehovah they were numbered by Moses, every one according to his service, and according to his burden: thus were they numbered of him, as Jehovah commanded Moses.

units.leftText: Then the LORD said to Moses,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “Command the Israelites to send away from the camp anyone with a skin disease, anyone who has a bodily discharge, and anyone who is defiled by a dead body.
units.rightText: Command the children of Israel, that they put out of the camp every leper, and every one that hath an issue, and whosoever is unclean by the dead:
leftNotes: 5:2 Forms of the Hebrew tzaraath, traditionally translated as leprosy, were used for various skin diseases; see Leviticus 13.

units.leftText: You must send away male and female alike; send them outside the camp so they will not defile their camp, where I dwell among them.”
units.rightText: both male and female shall ye put out, without the camp shall ye put them; that they defile not their camp, in the midst whereof I dwell.

units.leftText: So the Israelites did this, sending such people outside the camp. They did just as the LORD had instructed Moses. Confession and Restitution (Luke 19:1–10|LUK 19:1-10*)
units.rightText: And the children of Israel did so, and put them out without the camp; as Jehovah spake unto Moses, so did the children of Israel.

units.leftText: And the LORD said to Moses,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “Tell the Israelites that when a man or woman acts unfaithfully against the LORD by committing any sin against another, that person is guilty
units.rightText: Speak unto the children of Israel, When a man or woman shall commit any sin that men commit, so as to trespass against Jehovah, and that soul shall be guilty;

units.leftText: and must confess the sin he has committed. He must make full restitution, add a fifth to its value, and give all this to the one he has wronged.
units.rightText: then he shall confess his sin which he hath done: and he shall make restitution for his guilt in full, and add unto it the fifth part thereof, and give it unto him in respect of whom he hath been guilty.

units.leftText: But if the man has no relative to whom restitution can be made for the wrong, the restitution belongs to the LORD and must be given to the priest along with the ram of atonement, by which the atonement is made for him.
units.rightText: But if the man have no kinsman to whom restitution may be made for the guilt, the restitution for guilt which is made unto Jehovah shall be the priest’s; besides the ram of the atonement, whereby atonement shall be made for him.

units.leftText: Every sacred contribution the Israelites bring to the priest shall belong to him.
units.rightText: And every heave-offering of all the holy things of the children of Israel, which they present unto the priest, shall be his.

units.leftText: Each man’s sacred gifts are his own, but whatever he gives to the priest will belong to the priest.” The Adultery Test
units.rightText: And every man’s hallowed things shall be his: whatsoever any man giveth the priest, it shall be his.

units.leftText: Then the LORD said to Moses,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “Speak to the Israelites and tell them that if any man’s wife goes astray and is unfaithful to him
units.rightText: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, If any man’s wife go aside, and commit a trespass against him,

units.leftText: by sleeping with another man, and it is concealed from her husband and her impurity is undetected (since there is no witness against her and she was not caught in the act),
units.rightText: and a man lie with her carnally, and it be hid from the eyes of her husband, and be kept close, and she be defiled, and there be no witness against her, and she be not taken in the act;

units.leftText: and if a feeling of jealousy comes over her husband and he suspects his wife who has defiled herself— or if a feeling of jealousy comes over him and he suspects her even though she has not defiled herself—
units.rightText: and the spirit of jealousy come upon him, and he be jealous of his wife, and she be defiled: or if the spirit of jealousy come upon him, and he be jealous of his wife, and she be not defiled:

units.leftText: then he is to bring his wife to the priest. He must also bring for her an offering of a tenth of an ephah of barley flour. He is not to pour oil over it or put frankincense on it, because it is a grain offering for jealousy, an offering of memorial as a reminder of iniquity.
units.rightText: then shall the man bring his wife unto the priest, and shall bring her oblation for her, the tenth part of an ephah of barley meal; he shall pour no oil upon it, nor put frankincense thereon; for it is a meal-offering of jealousy, a meal-offering of memorial, bringing iniquity to remembrance.
leftNotes: 5:15 A tenth of an ephah is approximately 2 dry quarts or 2.2 liters (probably about 3.5 pounds or 1.6 kilograms of barley flour).

units.leftText: The priest is to bring the wife forward and have her stand before the LORD.
units.rightText: And the priest shall bring her near, and set her before Jehovah:

units.leftText: Then he is to take some holy water in a clay jar and put some of the dust from the tabernacle floor into the water.
units.rightText: and the priest shall take holy water in an earthen vessel; and of the dust that is on the floor of the tabernacle the priest shall take, and put it into the water.

units.leftText: After the priest has the woman stand before the LORD, he is to let down her hair and place in her hands the grain offering of memorial, which is the grain offering for jealousy. The priest is to hold the bitter water that brings a curse.
units.rightText: And the priest shall set the woman before Jehovah, and let the hair of the woman’s head go loose, and put the meal-offering of memorial in her hands, which is the meal-offering of jealousy: and the priest shall have in his hand the water of bitterness that causeth the curse.

units.leftText: And he is to put the woman under oath and say to her, ‘If no other man has slept with you and you have not gone astray and become defiled while under your husband’s authority, may you be immune to this bitter water that brings a curse.
units.rightText: And the priest shall cause her to swear, and shall say unto the woman, If no man have lain with thee, and if thou have not gone aside to uncleanness, being under thy husband, be thou free from this water of bitterness that causeth the curse.

units.leftText: But if you have gone astray while under your husband’s authority and have defiled yourself and lain carnally with a man other than your husband’—
units.rightText: But if thou have gone aside, being under thy husband, and if thou be defiled, and some man have lain with thee besides thy husband:

units.leftText: and the priest shall have the woman swear under the oath of the curse— ‘then may the LORD make you an attested curse among your people by making your thigh shrivel and your belly swell.
units.rightText: then the priest shall cause the woman to swear with the oath of cursing, and the priest shall say unto the woman, Jehovah make thee a curse and an oath among thy people, when Jehovah doth make thy thigh to fall away, and thy body to swell;

units.leftText: May this water that brings a curse enter your stomach and cause your belly to swell and your thigh to shrivel.’ Then the woman is to say, ‘Amen, Amen.’
units.rightText: and this water that causeth the curse shall go into thy bowels, and make thy body to swell, and thy thigh to fall away. And the woman shall say, Amen, Amen.

units.leftText: And the priest shall write these curses on a scroll and wash them off into the bitter water.
units.rightText: And the priest shall write these curses in a book, and he shall blot them out into the water of bitterness:

units.leftText: He is to have the woman drink the bitter water that brings a curse, and it will enter her and may cause her bitter suffering.
units.rightText: and he shall make the woman drink the water of bitterness that causeth the curse; and the water that causeth the curse shall enter into her and become bitter.

units.leftText: The priest shall take from her hand the grain offering for jealousy, wave it before the LORD, and bring it to the altar.
units.rightText: And the priest shall take the meal-offering of jealousy out of the woman’s hand, and shall wave the meal-offering before Jehovah, and bring it unto the altar:

units.leftText: Then the priest is to take a handful of the grain offering as a memorial portion and burn it on the altar; after that he is to have the woman drink the water.
units.rightText: and the priest shall take a handful of the meal-offering, as the memorial thereof, and burn it upon the altar, and afterward shall make the woman drink the water.

units.leftText: When he has made her drink the water, if she has defiled herself and been unfaithful to her husband, then the water that brings a curse will enter her and cause bitter suffering; her belly will swell, her thigh will shrivel, and she will become accursed among her people.
units.rightText: And when he hath made her drink the water, then it shall come to pass, if she be defiled, and have committed a trespass against her husband, that the water that causeth the curse shall enter into her and become bitter, and her body shall swell, and her thigh shall fall away: and the woman shall be a curse among her people.

units.leftText: But if the woman has not defiled herself and is clean, she will be unaffected and able to conceive children.
units.rightText: And if the woman be not defiled, but be clean; then she shall be free, and shall conceive seed.

units.leftText: This is the law of jealousy when a wife goes astray and defiles herself while under her husband’s authority,
units.rightText: This is the law of jealousy, when a wife, being under her husband, goeth aside, and is defiled;

units.leftText: or when a feeling of jealousy comes over a husband and he suspects his wife. He is to have the woman stand before the LORD, and the priest is to apply to her this entire law.
units.rightText: or when the spirit of jealousy cometh upon a man, and he is jealous of his wife; then shall he set the woman before Jehovah, and the priest shall execute upon her all this law.

units.leftText: The husband will be free from guilt, but the woman shall bear her iniquity.”
units.rightText: And the man shall be free from iniquity, and that woman shall bear her iniquity.

units.leftText: And the LORD said to Moses,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “Speak to the Israelites and tell them that if a man or woman makes a special vow, the vow of a Nazirite, to separate himself to the LORD,
units.rightText: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When either man or woman shall make a special vow, the vow of a Nazirite, to separate himself unto Jehovah,
leftNotes: 6:2 Nazirite means one separated or one consecrated.

units.leftText: he is to abstain from wine and strong drink. He must not drink vinegar made from wine or strong drink, and he must not drink any grape juice or eat fresh grapes or raisins.
units.rightText: he shall separate himself from wine and strong drink; he shall drink no vinegar of wine, or vinegar of strong drink, neither shall he drink any juice of grapes, nor eat fresh grapes or dried.

units.leftText: All the days of his separation, he is not to eat anything that comes from the grapevine, not even the seeds or skins.
units.rightText: All the days of his separation shall he eat nothing that is made of the grape-vine, from the kernels even to the husk.

units.leftText: For the entire period of his vow of separation, no razor shall touch his head. He must be holy until the time of his separation to the LORD is complete; he must let the hair of his head grow long.
units.rightText: All the days of his vow of separation there shall no razor come upon his head: until the days be fulfilled, in which he separateth himself unto Jehovah, he shall be holy; he shall let the locks of the hair of his head grow long.

units.leftText: Throughout the days of his separation to the LORD, he must not go near a dead body.
units.rightText: All the days that he separateth himself unto Jehovah he shall not come near to a dead body.

units.leftText: Even if his father or mother or brother or sister should die, he is not to defile himself, because the symbol of consecration to his God is upon his head.
units.rightText: He shall not make himself unclean for his father, or for his mother, for his brother, or for his sister, when they die; because his separation unto God is upon his head.

units.leftText: Throughout the time of his separation, he is holy to the LORD.
units.rightText: All the days of his separation he is holy unto Jehovah.

units.leftText: If someone suddenly dies in his presence and defiles his consecrated head of hair, he must shave his head on the day of his cleansing — the seventh day.
units.rightText: And if any man die very suddenly beside him, and he defile the head of his separation; then he shall shave his head in the day of his cleansing, on the seventh day shall he shave it.

units.leftText: On the eighth day he must bring two turtledoves or two young pigeons to the priest at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
units.rightText: And on the eighth day he shall bring two turtle-doves, or two young pigeons, to the priest, to the door of the tent of meeting:

units.leftText: And the priest is to offer one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering to make atonement for him, because he has sinned by being in the presence of the dead body. On that day he must consecrate his head again.
units.rightText: and the priest shall offer one for a sin-offering, and the other for a burnt-offering, and make atonement for him, for that he sinned by reason of the dead, and shall hallow his head that same day.
leftNotes: 6:11 Or purification offering; here and throughout Numbers

units.leftText: He must rededicate his time of separation to the LORD and bring a year-old male lamb as a guilt offering. But the preceding days shall not be counted, because his separation was defiled.
units.rightText: And he shall separate unto Jehovah the days of his separation, and shall bring a he-lamb a year old for a trespass-offering; but the former days shall be void, because his separation was defiled.

units.leftText: Now this is the law of the Nazirite when his time of separation is complete: He must be brought to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting,
units.rightText: And this is the law of the Nazirite, when the days of his separation are fulfilled: he shall be brought unto the door of the tent of meeting:

units.leftText: and he is to present an offering to the LORD of an unblemished year-old male lamb as a burnt offering, an unblemished year-old female lamb as a sin offering, and an unblemished ram as a peace offering —
units.rightText: and he shall offer his oblation unto Jehovah, one he-lamb a year old without blemish for a burnt-offering, and one ewe-lamb a year old without blemish for a sin-offering, and one ram without blemish for peace-offerings,

units.leftText: together with their grain offerings and drink offerings — and a basket of unleavened cakes made from fine flour mixed with oil and unleavened wafers coated with oil.
units.rightText: and a basket of unleavened bread, cakes of fine flour mingled with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and their meal-offering, and their drink-offerings.

units.leftText: The priest is to present all these before the LORD and make the sin offering and the burnt offering.
units.rightText: And the priest shall present them before Jehovah, and shall offer his sin-offering, and his burnt-offering:

units.leftText: He shall also offer the ram as a peace offering to the LORD, along with the basket of unleavened bread. And the priest is to offer the accompanying grain offering and drink offering.
units.rightText: and he shall offer the ram for a sacrifice of peace-offerings unto Jehovah, with the basket of unleavened bread: the priest shall offer also the meal-offering thereof, and the drink-offering thereof.

units.leftText: Then at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting, the Nazirite is to shave his consecrated head, take the hair, and put it on the fire under the peace offering.
units.rightText: And the Nazirite shall shave the head of his separation at the door of the tent of meeting, and shall take the hair of the head of his separation, and put it on the fire which is under the sacrifice of peace-offerings.

units.leftText: And the priest is to take the boiled shoulder from the ram, one unleavened cake from the basket, and one unleavened wafer, and put them into the hands of the Nazirite who has just shaved the hair of his consecration.
units.rightText: And the priest shall take the boiled shoulder of the ram, and one unleavened cake out of the basket, and one unleavened wafer, and shall put them upon the hands of the Nazirite, after he hath shaven the head of his separation;

units.leftText: The priest shall then wave them as a wave offering before the LORD. This is a holy portion for the priest, in addition to the breast of the wave offering and the thigh that was presented. After that, the Nazirite may drink wine.
units.rightText: and the priest shall wave them for a wave-offering before Jehovah; this is holy for the priest, together with the wave-breast and heave-thigh: and after that the Nazirite may drink wine.

units.leftText: This is the law of the Nazirite who vows his offering to the LORD for his separation, in addition to whatever else he can afford; he must fulfill whatever vow he makes, according to the law of his separation.” Aaron’s Blessing
units.rightText: This is the law of the Nazirite who voweth, and of his oblation unto Jehovah for his separation, besides that which he is able to get: according to his vow which he voweth, so he must do after the law of his separation.

units.leftText: Then the LORD said to Moses,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “Tell Aaron and his sons:This is how you are to bless the Israelites. Say to them:
units.rightText: Speak unto Aaron and unto his sons, saying, On this wise ye shall bless the children of Israel: ye shall say unto them,

units.leftText: ‘May the LORD bless you and keep you;
units.rightText: Jehovah bless thee, and keep thee:

units.leftText: may the LORD cause His face to shine upon you and be gracious to you;
units.rightText: Jehovah make his face to shine upon thee, and be gracious unto thee:

units.leftText: may the LORD lift up His countenance toward you and give you peace.’
units.rightText: Jehovah lift up his countenance upon thee, and give thee peace.

units.leftText: So they shall put My name on the Israelites, and I will bless them.”
units.rightText: So shall they put my name upon the children of Israel; and I will bless them.

units.leftText: On the day Moses finished setting up the tabernacle, he anointed and consecrated it and all its furnishings, along with the altar and all its utensils.
units.rightText: And it came to pass on the day that Moses had made an end of setting up the tabernacle, and had anointed it and sanctified it, and all the furniture thereof, and the altar and all the vessels thereof, and had anointed them and sanctified them;

units.leftText: And the leaders of Israel, the heads of their families, presented an offering. These men were the tribal leaders who had supervised the registration.
units.rightText: that the princes of Israel, the heads of their fathers’ houses, offered. These were the princes of the tribes, these are they that were over them that were numbered:

units.leftText: They brought as their offering before the LORD six covered carts and twelve oxen — an ox from each leader and a cart from every two leaders — and presented them before the tabernacle.
units.rightText: and they brought their oblation before Jehovah, six covered wagons, and twelve oxen; a wagon for every two of the princes, and for each one an ox: and they presented them before the tabernacle.

units.leftText: And the LORD said to Moses,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “Accept these gifts from them, that they may be used in the work of the Tent of Meeting. And give them to the Levites, to each man according to his service.”
units.rightText: Take it of them, that they may be used in doing the service of the tent of meeting; and thou shalt give them unto the Levites, to every man according to his service.

units.leftText: So Moses took the carts and oxen and gave them to the Levites.
units.rightText: And Moses took the wagons and the oxen, and gave them unto the Levites.

units.leftText: He gave the Gershonites two carts and four oxen, as their service required,
units.rightText: Two wagons and four oxen he gave unto the sons of Gershon, according to their service:

units.leftText: and he gave the Merarites four carts and eight oxen, as their service required, all under the direction of Ithamar son of Aaron the priest.

units.leftText: But he did not give any to the Kohathites, since they were to carry on their shoulders the holy objects for which they were responsible.
units.rightText: But unto the sons of Kohath he gave none, because the service of the sanctuary belonged unto them; they bare it upon their shoulders.

units.leftText: When the altar was anointed, the leaders approached with their offerings for its dedication and presented them before the altar.
units.rightText: And the princes offered for the dedication of the altar in the day that it was anointed, even the princes offered their oblation before the altar.

units.leftText: And the LORD said to Moses, “Each day one leader is to present his offering for the dedication of the altar.”
units.rightText: And Jehovah said unto Moses, They shall offer their oblation, each prince on his day, for the dedication of the altar.

units.rightText: On the twelfth day Ahira the son of Enan, prince of the children of Naphtali:

units.leftText: His offering was one silver platter weighing a hundred and thirty shekels, and one silver bowl weighing seventy shekels, both according to the sanctuary shekel and filled with fine flour mixed with oil for a grain offering;
units.rightText: his oblation was one silver platter, the weight whereof was a hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meal-offering;

units.leftText: one gold dish weighing ten shekels, filled with incense;
units.rightText: one golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense;

units.leftText: one young bull, one ram, and one male lamb a year old for a burnt offering;
units.rightText: one young bullock, one ram, one he-lamb a year old, for a burnt-offering;

units.leftText: one male goat for a sin offering;
units.rightText: one male of the goats for a sin-offering;

units.leftText: and a peace offering of two oxen, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Ahira son of Enan.
units.rightText: and for the sacrifice of peace-offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he-goats, five he-lambs a year old: this was the oblation of Ahira the son of Enan.

units.leftText: So these were the offerings from the leaders of Israel for the dedication of the altar when it was anointed: twelve silver platters, twelve silver bowls, and twelve gold dishes.
units.rightText: This was the dedication of the altar, in the day when it was anointed, by the princes of Israel: twelve silver platters, twelve silver bowls, twelve golden spoons;

units.leftText: Each silver platter weighed a hundred and thirty shekels, and each silver bowl seventy shekels. The total weight of the silver articles was two thousand four hundred shekels, according to the sanctuary shekel.
units.rightText: each silver platter weighing a hundred and thirty shekels, and each bowl seventy; all the silver of the vessels two thousand and four hundred shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary;
leftNotes: 7:85 2,400 shekels is approximately 60.3 pounds or 27.4 kilograms.

units.leftText: The twelve gold dishes filled with incense weighed ten shekels each, according to the sanctuary shekel. The total weight of the gold dishes was a hundred and twenty shekels.
units.rightText: the twelve golden spoons, full of incense, weighing ten shekels apiece, after the shekel of the sanctuary; all the gold of the spoons a hundred and twenty shekels;
leftNotes: 7:86 120 shekels is approximately 3 pounds or 1.4 kilograms.

units.leftText: All the livestock for the burnt offering totaled twelve bulls, twelve rams, and twelve male lambs a year old — together with their grain offerings — and twelve male goats for the sin offering.
units.rightText: all the oxen for the burnt-offering twelve bullocks, the rams twelve, the he-lambs a year old twelve, and their meal-offering; and the males of the goats for a sin-offering twelve;

units.leftText: All the livestock sacrificed for the peace offering totaled twenty-four bulls, sixty rams, sixty male goats, and sixty male lambs a year old. This was the dedication offering for the altar after it was anointed.
units.rightText: and all the oxen for the sacrifice of peace-offerings twenty and four bullocks, the rams sixty, the he-goats sixty, the he-lambs a year old sixty. This was the dedication of the altar, after that it was anointed.

units.leftText: When Moses entered the Tent of Meeting to speak with the LORD, he heard the voice speaking to him from between the two cherubim above the mercy seat on the ark of the Testimony. Thus the LORD spoke to him.
units.rightText: And when Moses went into the tent of meeting to speak with him, then he heard the Voice speaking unto him from above the mercy-seat that was upon the ark of the testimony, from between the two cherubim: and he spake unto him.
leftNotes: 7:89 Or atonement cover
7:89 That is, the ark of the covenant

units.leftText: Then the LORD said to Moses,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “Speak to Aaron and tell him: ‘When you set up the seven lamps, they are to light the area in front of the lampstand.’”
