units.leftText: “If we have found favor in your sight,” they said, “let this land be given to your servants as a possession. Do not make us cross the Jordan.”
units.rightText: And they said, If we have found favor in thy sight, let this land be given unto thy servants for a possession; bring us not over the Jordan.

units.leftText: But Moses asked the Gadites and Reubenites, “Shall your brothers go to war while you sit here?
units.rightText: And Moses said unto the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, Shall your brethren go to the war, and shall ye sit here?

units.leftText: Why are you discouraging the Israelites from crossing into the land that the LORD has given them?
units.rightText: And wherefore discourage ye the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which Jehovah hath given them?

units.leftText: This is what your fathers did when I sent them from Kadesh-barnea to inspect the land.
units.rightText: Thus did your fathers, when I sent them from Kadesh-barnea to see the land.

units.leftText: For when your fathers went up to the Valley of Eshcol and saw the land, they discouraged the Israelites from entering the land that the LORD had given them.
units.rightText: For when they went up unto the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, they discouraged the heart of the children of Israel, that they should not go into the land which Jehovah had given them.

units.leftText: So the anger of the LORD was kindled that day, and He swore an oath, saying,
units.rightText: And Jehovah’s anger was kindled in that day, and he sware, saying,

units.leftText: ‘Because they did not follow Me wholeheartedly, not one of the men twenty years of age or older who came out of Egypt will see the land that I swore to give Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob—
units.rightText: Surely none of the men that came up out of Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land which I sware unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob; because they have not wholly followed me:

units.leftText: not one except Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite and Joshua son of Nun— because they did follow the LORD wholeheartedly.’
units.rightText: save Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite, and Joshua the son of Nun; because they have wholly followed Jehovah.

units.leftText: The anger of the LORD burned against Israel, and He made them wander in the wilderness forty years, until the whole generation who had done evil in His sight was gone.
units.rightText: And Jehovah’s anger was kindled against Israel, and he made them wander to and fro in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation, that had done evil in the sight of Jehovah, was consumed.

units.leftText: Now behold, you, a brood of sinners, have risen up in place of your fathers to further stoke the burning anger of the LORD against Israel.
units.rightText: And, behold, ye are risen up in your fathers’ stead, an increase of sinful men, to augment yet the fierce anger of Jehovah toward Israel.

units.leftText: For if you turn away from following Him, He will once again leave this people in the wilderness, and you will be the cause of their destruction.”
units.rightText: For if ye turn away from after him, he will yet again leave them in the wilderness; and ye will destroy all this people.

units.leftText: Then the Gadites and Reubenites approached Moses and said, “We want to build sheepfolds here for our livestock and cities for our little ones.
units.rightText: And they came near unto him, and said, We will build sheepfolds here for our cattle, and cities for our little ones:

units.leftText: But we will arm ourselves and be ready to go ahead of the Israelites until we have brought them into their place. Meanwhile, our little ones will remain in the fortified cities for protection from the inhabitants of the land.
units.rightText: but we ourselves will be ready armed to go before the children of Israel, until we have brought them unto their place: and our little ones shall dwell in the fortified cities because of the inhabitants of the land.
leftNotes: 32:17 LXX we will arm ourselves for battle

units.leftText: We will not return to our homes until every Israelite has taken possession of his inheritance.
units.rightText: We will not return unto our houses, until the children of Israel have inherited every man his inheritance.

units.leftText: Yet we will not have an inheritance with them across the Jordan and beyond, because our inheritance has come to us on the east side of the Jordan.”
units.rightText: For we will not inherit with them on the other side of the Jordan, and forward; because our inheritance is fallen to us on this side of the Jordan eastward.

units.leftText: Moses replied, “If you will do this— if you will arm yourselves before the LORD for battle,
units.rightText: And Moses said unto them, If ye will do this thing, if ye will arm yourselves to go before Jehovah to the war,

units.leftText: and if every one of your armed men crosses the Jordan before the LORD, until He has driven His enemies out before Him,
units.rightText: and every armed man of you will pass over the Jordan before Jehovah, until he hath driven out his enemies from before him,

units.leftText: then when the land is subdued before the LORD, you may return and be free of obligation to the LORD and to Israel. And this land will belong to you as a possession before the LORD.
units.rightText: and the land is subdued before Jehovah; then afterward ye shall return, and be guiltless towards Jehovah, and towards Israel; and this land shall be unto you for a possession before Jehovah.

units.leftText: But if you do not do this, you will certainly sin against the LORD — and be assured that your sin will find you out.
units.rightText: But if ye will not do so, behold, ye have sinned against Jehovah; and be sure your sin will find you out.

units.leftText: Build cities for your little ones and folds for your flocks, but do what you have promised.”
units.rightText: Build you cities for your little ones, and folds for your sheep; and do that which hath proceeded out of your mouth.

units.leftText: The Gadites and Reubenites said to Moses, “Your servants will do just as our lord commands.
units.rightText: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben spake unto Moses, saying, Thy servants will do as my lord commandeth.

units.leftText: Our children, our wives, our livestock, and all our animals will remain here in the cities of Gilead.
units.rightText: Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our cattle, shall be there in the cities of Gilead;

units.leftText: But your servants are equipped for war, and every man will cross over to the battle before the LORD, just as our lord says.”
units.rightText: but thy servants will pass over, every man that is armed for war, before Jehovah to battle, as my lord saith.

units.leftText: So Moses gave orders about them to Eleazar the priest, to Joshua son of Nun, and to the family leaders of the tribes of Israel.
units.rightText: So Moses gave charge concerning them to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the heads of the fathers’ houses of the tribes of the children of Israel.

units.leftText: And Moses said to them, “If the Gadites and Reubenites cross the Jordan with you, with every man armed for battle before the LORD, and the land is subdued before you, then you are to give them the land of Gilead as a possession.
units.rightText: And Moses said unto them, If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over the Jordan, every man that is armed to battle, before Jehovah, and the land shall be subdued before you; then ye shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession:

units.leftText: But if they do not arm themselves and go across with you, then they must accept their possession among you in the land of Canaan.”
units.rightText: but if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.

units.leftText: The Gadites and Reubenites replied, “As the LORD has spoken to your servants, so we will do.
units.rightText: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, As Jehovah hath said unto thy servants, so will we do.

units.leftText: We will cross over into the land of Canaan armed before the LORD, that we may have our inheritance on this side of the Jordan.”
units.rightText: We will pass over armed before Jehovah into the land of Canaan, and the possession of our inheritance shall remain with us beyond the Jordan.

units.leftText: So Moses gave to the Gadites, to the Reubenites, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh son of Joseph the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan — the land including its cities and the territory surrounding them.
units.rightText: And Moses gave unto them, even to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and unto the half-tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, the land, according to the cities thereof with their borders, even the cities of the land round about.

units.leftText: And the Gadites built up Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer,
units.rightText: And the children of Gad built Dibon, and Ataroth, and Aroer,

units.leftText: Atroth-shophan, Jazer, Jogbehah,
units.rightText: and Atroth-shophan, and Jazer, and Jogbehah,

units.leftText: Beth-nimrah, and Beth-haran as fortified cities, and they built folds for their flocks.
units.rightText: and Beth-nimrah, and Beth-haran: fortified cities, and folds for sheep.

units.leftText: The Reubenites built up Heshbon, Elealeh, Kiriathaim,
units.rightText: And the children of Reuben built Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Kiriathaim,

units.leftText: as well as Nebo and Baal-meon (whose names were changed), and Sibmah. And they renamed the cities they rebuilt.
units.rightText: and Nebo, and Baal-meon, (their names being changed,) and Sibmah: and they gave other names unto the cities which they builded.

units.leftText: The descendants of Machir son of Manasseh went to Gilead, captured it, and drove out the Amorites who were there.
units.rightText: And the children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead, and took it, and dispossessed the Amorites that were therein.

units.leftText: So Moses gave Gilead to the clan of Machir son of Manasseh, and they settled there.
units.rightText: And Moses gave Gilead unto Machir the son of Manasseh; and he dwelt therein.

units.leftText: Jair, a descendant of Manasseh, went and captured their villages and called them Havvoth-jair.
units.rightText: And Jair the son of Manasseh went and took the towns thereof, and called them Havvoth-jair.
leftNotes: 32:41 Havvoth-jair means the villages of Jair.

units.leftText: And Nobah went and captured Kenath and its villages and called it Nobah, after his own name.
units.rightText: And Nobah went and took Kenath, and the villages thereof, and called it Nobah, after his own name.

units.leftText: These are the journeys of the Israelites when they came out of the land of Egypt by their divisions under the leadership of Moses and Aaron.
units.rightText: These are the journeys of the children of Israel, when they went forth out of the land of Egypt by their hosts under the hand of Moses and Aaron.

units.leftText: At the LORD’s command, Moses recorded the stages of their journey. These are the stages listed by their starting points:
units.rightText: And Moses wrote their goings out according to their journeys by the commandment of Jehovah: and these are their journeys according to their goings out.

units.leftText: On the fifteenth day of the first month, on the day after the Passover, the Israelites set out from Rameses. They marched out defiantly in full view of all the Egyptians,
units.rightText: And they journeyed from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the morrow after the passover the children of Israel went out with a high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians,
leftNotes: 33:3 Or marched out boldly; literally marched out with an upraised hand

units.leftText: who were burying all their firstborn, whom the LORD had struck down among them; for the LORD had executed judgment against their gods.
units.rightText: while the Egyptians were burying all their first-born, whom Jehovah had smitten among them: upon their gods also Jehovah executed judgments.

units.leftText: The Israelites set out from Rameses and camped at Succoth.
units.rightText: And the children of Israel journeyed from Rameses, and encamped in Succoth.

units.leftText: They set out from Succoth and camped at Etham, on the edge of the wilderness.
units.rightText: And they journeyed from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, which is in the edge of the wilderness.

units.leftText: They set out from Etham and turned back to Pi-hahiroth, opposite Baal-zephon, and they camped near Migdol.
units.rightText: And they journeyed from Etham, and turned back unto Pi-hahiroth, which is before Baal-zephon: and they encamped before Migdol.

units.leftText: They set out from Pi-hahiroth and crossed through the sea, into the wilderness, and they journeyed three days into the Wilderness of Etham and camped at Marah.
units.rightText: And they journeyed from before Hahiroth, and passed through the midst of the sea into the wilderness: and they went three days’ journey in the wilderness of Etham, and encamped in Marah.
leftNotes: 33:8 Some Hebrew manuscripts, SP, and Vulgate; see verse 7; most MT manuscripts Hahiroth

units.leftText: They set out from Marah and came to Elim, where there were twelve springs and seventy palm trees, and they camped there.
units.rightText: And they journeyed from Marah, and came unto Elim: and in Elim were twelve springs of water, and threescore and ten palm-trees; and they encamped there.

units.leftText: They set out from Elim and camped by the Red Sea.
units.rightText: And they journeyed from Elim, and encamped by the Red Sea.
leftNotes: 33:10 Or the Sea of Reeds; also in verse 11

units.leftText: They set out from the Red Sea and camped in the Desert of Sin.
units.rightText: And they journeyed from the Red Sea, and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.
leftNotes: 33:11 The geographical name Sin is related to Sinai and should not be mistaken for the English word sin; also in verse 12.

units.leftText: They set out from the Desert of Sin and camped at Dophkah.
units.rightText: And they journeyed from the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in Dophkah.

units.leftText: They set out from Dophkah and camped at Alush.
units.rightText: And they journeyed from Dophkah, and encamped in Alush.

units.leftText: They set out from Alush and camped at Rephidim, where there was no water for the people to drink.
units.rightText: And they journeyed from Alush, and encamped in Rephidim, where was no water for the people to drink.

units.leftText: They set out from Rephidim and camped in the Wilderness of Sinai.
units.rightText: And they journeyed from Rephidim, and encamped in the wilderness of Sinai.

units.leftText: They set out from the Wilderness of Sinai and camped at Kibroth-hattaavah.
units.rightText: And they journeyed from the wilderness of Sinai, and encamped in Kibroth-hattaavah.

units.leftText: They set out from Kibroth-hattaavah and camped at Hazeroth.
units.rightText: And they journeyed from Kibroth-hattaavah, and encamped in Hazeroth.

units.leftText: They set out from Hazeroth and camped at Rithmah.
units.rightText: And they journeyed from Hazeroth, and encamped in Rithmah.

units.leftText: They set out from Rithmah and camped at Rimmon-perez.
units.rightText: And they journeyed from Rithmah, and encamped in Rimmon-perez.

units.leftText: They set out from Rimmon-perez and camped at Libnah.
units.rightText: And they journeyed from Rimmon-perez, and encamped in Libnah.

units.leftText: They set out from Libnah and camped at Rissah.
units.rightText: And they journeyed from Libnah, and encamped in Rissah.

units.leftText: They set out from Rissah and camped at Kehelathah.
units.rightText: And they journeyed from Rissah, and encamped in Kehelathah.

units.leftText: They set out from Kehelathah and camped at Mount Shepher.
units.rightText: And they journeyed from Kehelathah, and encamped in mount Shepher.

units.leftText: They set out from Mount Shepher and camped at Haradah.
units.rightText: And they journeyed from mount Shepher, and encamped in Haradah.

units.leftText: They set out from Haradah and camped at Makheloth.
units.rightText: And they journeyed from Haradah, and encamped in Makheloth.

units.leftText: They set out from Makheloth and camped at Tahath.
units.rightText: And they journeyed from Makheloth, and encamped in Tahath.

units.leftText: They set out from Tahath and camped at Terah.
units.rightText: And they journeyed from Tahath, and encamped in Terah.

units.leftText: They set out from Terah and camped at Mithkah.
units.rightText: And they journeyed from Terah, and encamped in Mithkah.

units.leftText: They set out from Mithkah and camped at Hashmonah.
units.rightText: And they journeyed from Mithkah, and encamped in Hashmonah.

units.leftText: They set out from Hashmonah and camped at Moseroth.
units.rightText: And they journeyed from Hashmonah, and encamped in Moseroth.

units.leftText: They set out from Moseroth and camped at Bene-jaakan.
units.rightText: And they journeyed from Moseroth, and encamped in Bene-jaakan.

units.leftText: They set out from Bene-jaakan and camped at Hor-haggidgad.
units.rightText: And they journeyed from Bene-jaakan, and encamped in Hor-haggidgad.

units.leftText: They set out from Hor-haggidgad and camped at Jotbathah.
units.rightText: And they journeyed from Hor-haggidgad, and encamped in Jotbathah.

units.leftText: They set out from Jotbathah and camped at Abronah.
units.rightText: And they journeyed from Jotbathah, and encamped in Abronah.

units.leftText: They set out from Abronah and camped at Ezion-geber.
units.rightText: And they journeyed from Abronah, and encamped in Ezion-geber.

units.leftText: They set out from Ezion-geber and camped at Kadesh in the Wilderness of Zin.
units.rightText: And they journeyed from Ezion-geber, and encamped in the wilderness of Zin (the same is Kadesh).

units.leftText: They set out from Kadesh and camped at Mount Hor, on the outskirts of the land of Edom.
units.rightText: And they journeyed from Kadesh, and encamped in mount Hor, in the edge of the land of Edom.

units.leftText: At the LORD’s command, Aaron the priest climbed Mount Hor and died there on the first day of the fifth month, in the fortieth year after the Israelites had come out of the land of Egypt.
units.rightText: And Aaron the priest went up into mount Hor at the commandment of Jehovah, and died there, in the fortieth year after the children of Israel were come out of the land of Egypt, in the fifth month, on the first day of the month.

units.leftText: Aaron was 123 years old when he died on Mount Hor.
units.rightText: And Aaron was a hundred and twenty and three years old when he died in mount Hor.

units.leftText: Now the Canaanite king of Arad, who lived in the Negev in the land of Canaan, heard that the Israelites were coming.
units.rightText: And the Canaanite, the king of Arad, who dwelt in the South in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Israel.

units.leftText: And the Israelites set out from Mount Hor and camped at Zalmonah.
units.rightText: And they journeyed from mount Hor, and encamped in Zalmonah.

units.leftText: They set out from Zalmonah and camped at Punon.
units.rightText: And they journeyed from Zalmonah, and encamped in Punon.

units.leftText: They set out from Punon and camped at Oboth.
units.rightText: And they journeyed from Punon, and encamped in Oboth.

units.leftText: They set out from Oboth and camped at Iye-abarim on the border of Moab.
units.rightText: And they journeyed from Oboth, and encamped in Iye-abarim, in the border of Moab.

units.leftText: They set out from Iyim and camped at Dibon-gad.
units.rightText: And they journeyed from Iyim, and encamped in Dibon-gad.
leftNotes: 33:45 Iyim is another name for Iye-abarim; see verse 44.

units.leftText: They set out from Dibon-gad and camped at Almon-diblathaim.
units.rightText: And they journeyed from Dibon-gad, and encamped in Almon-diblathaim.

units.leftText: They set out from Almon-diblathaim and camped in the mountains of Abarim facing Nebo.
units.rightText: And they journeyed from Almon-diblathaim, and encamped in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.
leftNotes: 33:47 Or the mountains beyond the river; also in verse 48

units.leftText: They set out from the mountains of Abarim and camped on the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho.
units.rightText: And they journeyed from the mountains of Abarim, and encamped in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.

units.leftText: And there on the plains of Moab they camped by the Jordan, from Beth-jeshimoth to Abel-shittim. Instructions for Occupying Canaan
units.rightText: And they encamped by the Jordan, from Beth-jeshimoth even unto Abel-shittim in the plains of Moab.
leftNotes: 33:49 Or the Meadow of the Acacias; that is, an area in the lowlands of Moab

units.leftText: On the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho, the LORD said to Moses,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,

units.leftText: “Speak to the Israelites and tell them: When you cross the Jordan into the land of Canaan,
units.rightText: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye pass over the Jordan into the land of Canaan,

units.leftText: you must drive out before you all the inhabitants of the land, destroy all their carved images and cast idols, and demolish all their high places.
units.rightText: then ye shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, and destroy all their figured stones, and destroy all their molten images, and demolish all their high places:

units.leftText: You are to take possession of the land and settle in it, for I have given you the land to possess.
units.rightText: and ye shall take possession of the land, and dwell therein; for unto you have I given the land to possess it.

units.leftText: And you are to divide the land by lot according to your clans. Give a larger inheritance to a larger clan and a smaller inheritance to a smaller one. Whatever falls to each one by lot will be his. You will receive an inheritance according to the tribes of your fathers.
units.rightText: And ye shall inherit the land by lot according to your families; to the more ye shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer thou shalt give the less inheritance: wheresoever the lot falleth to any man, that shall be his; according to the tribes of your fathers shall ye inherit.

units.leftText: But if you do not drive out the inhabitants of the land before you, those you allow to remain will become barbs in your eyes and thorns in your sides; they will harass you in the land where you settle.
units.rightText: But if ye will not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you, then shall those that ye let remain of them be as pricks in your eyes, and as thorns in your sides, and they shall vex you in the land wherein ye dwell.

units.leftText: And then I will do to you what I had planned to do to them.”
units.rightText: And it shall come to pass, that, as I thought to do unto them, so will I do unto you.

units.leftText: Then the LORD said to Moses,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “Command the Israelites and say to them: When you enter the land of Canaan, it will be allotted to you as an inheritance with these boundaries:
units.rightText: Command the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land of Canaan (this is the land that shall fall unto you for an inheritance, even the land of Canaan according to the borders thereof),

units.leftText: Your southern border will extend from the Wilderness of Zin along the border of Edom. On the east, your southern border will run from the end of the Salt Sea,
units.rightText: then your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the side of Edom, and your south border shall be from the end of the Salt Sea eastward;
leftNotes: 34:3 That is, the Dead Sea; also in verse 12

units.leftText: cross south of the Ascent of Akrabbim, continue to Zin, and go south of Kadesh-barnea. Then it will go on to Hazar-addar and proceed to Azmon,
units.rightText: and your border shall turn about southward of the ascent of Akrabbim, and pass along to Zin; and the goings out thereof shall be southward of Kadesh-barnea; and it shall go forth to Hazar-addar, and pass along to Azmon;
leftNotes: 34:4 Or the Ascent of Scorpions or Scorpion Pass

units.leftText: where it will turn from Azmon, join the Brook of Egypt, and end at the Sea.
units.rightText: and the border shall turn about from Azmon unto the brook of Egypt, and the goings out thereof shall be at the sea.
leftNotes: 34:5 That is, the Mediterranean Sea, also called the Great Sea; also in verses 6 and 7

units.leftText: Your western border will be the coastline of the Great Sea; this will be your boundary on the west.
units.rightText: And for the western border, ye shall have the great sea and the border thereof: this shall be your west border.

units.leftText: Your northern border will run from the Great Sea directly to Mount Hor,
units.rightText: And this shall be your north border: from the great sea ye shall mark out for you mount Hor;

units.leftText: and from Mount Hor to Lebo-hamath, then extend to Zedad,
units.rightText: from mount Hor ye shall mark out unto the entrance of Hamath; and the goings out of the border shall be at Zedad;

units.leftText: continue to Ziphron, and end at Hazar-enan. This will be your boundary on the north.
units.rightText: and the border shall go forth to Ziphron, and the goings out thereof shall be at Hazar-enan: this shall be your north border.

units.leftText: And your eastern border will run straight from Hazar-enan to Shepham,
units.rightText: And ye shall mark out your east border from Hazar-enan to Shepham;

units.leftText: then go down from Shepham to Riblah on the east side of Ain and continue along the slopes east of the Sea of Chinnereth.
units.rightText: and the border shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain; and the border shall go down, and shall reach unto the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward;
leftNotes: 34:11 That is, the Sea of Galilee

units.leftText: Then the border will go down along the Jordan and end at the Salt Sea. This will be your land, defined by its borders on all sides.”
units.rightText: and the border shall go down to the Jordan, and the goings out thereof shall be at the Salt Sea. This shall be your land according to the borders thereof round about.

units.leftText: So Moses commanded the Israelites, “Apportion this land by lot as an inheritance. The LORD has commanded that it be given to the nine and a half tribes.
units.rightText: And Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying, This is the land which ye shall inherit by lot, which Jehovah hath commanded to give unto the nine tribes, and to the half-tribe;

units.leftText: For the tribes of the Reubenites and Gadites, along with the half-tribe of Manasseh, have already received their inheritance.
units.rightText: for the tribe of the children of Reuben according to their fathers’ houses, and the tribe of the children of Gad according to their fathers’ houses, have received, and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received, their inheritance:

units.leftText: These two and a half tribes have received their inheritance across the Jordan from Jericho, toward the sunrise.” Leaders to Divide the Land
units.rightText: the two tribes and the half-tribe have received their inheritance beyond the Jordan at Jericho eastward, toward the sunrising.

units.leftText: Then the LORD said to Moses,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “These are the names of the men who are to assign the land as an inheritance for you: Eleazar the priest and Joshua son of Nun.
units.rightText: These are the names of the men that shall divide the land unto you for inheritance: Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun.

units.leftText: Appoint one leader from each tribe to distribute the land.
units.rightText: And ye shall take one prince of every tribe, to divide the land for inheritance.

units.leftText: These are their names: Caleb son of Jephunneh from the tribe of Judah;
units.rightText: And these are the names of the men: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

units.leftText: Shemuel son of Ammihud from the tribe of Simeon;
units.rightText: And of the tribe of the children of Simeon, Shemuel the son of Ammihud.

units.leftText: Elidad son of Chislon from the tribe of Benjamin;
units.rightText: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon.

units.leftText: Bukki son of Jogli, a leader from the tribe of Dan;
units.rightText: And of the tribe of the children of Dan a prince, Bukki the son of Jogli.

units.leftText: Hanniel son of Ephod, a leader from the tribe of Manasseh son of Joseph;
units.rightText: Of the children of Joseph: of the tribe of the children of Manasseh a prince, Hanniel the son of Ephod.

units.leftText: Kemuel son of Shiphtan, a leader from the tribe of Ephraim;
units.rightText: And of the tribe of the children of Ephraim a prince, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan.

units.leftText: Eli-zaphan son of Parnach, a leader from the tribe of Zebulun;
units.rightText: And of the tribe of the children of Zebulun a prince, Elizaphan the son of Parnach.

units.leftText: Paltiel son of Azzan, a leader from the tribe of Issachar;
units.rightText: And of the tribe of the children of Issachar a prince, Paltiel the son of Azzan.

units.leftText: Ahihud son of Shelomi, a leader from the tribe of Asher;
units.rightText: And of the tribe of the children of Asher a prince, Ahihud the son of Shelomi.

units.leftText: and Pedahel son of Ammihud, a leader from the tribe of Naphtali.”
units.rightText: And of the tribe of the children of Naphtali a prince, Pedahel the son of Ammihud.

units.leftText: These are the ones whom the LORD commanded to apportion the inheritance to the Israelites in the land of Canaan.
units.rightText: These are they whom Jehovah commanded to divide the inheritance unto the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.

units.leftText: Again the LORD spoke to Moses on the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho:
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,

units.leftText: “Command the Israelites to give, from the inheritance they will possess, cities for the Levites to live in and pasturelands around the cities.
units.rightText: Command the children of Israel, that they give unto the Levites of the inheritance of their possession cities to dwell in; and suburbs for the cities round about them shall ye give unto the Levites.

units.leftText: The cities will be for them to live in, and the pasturelands will be for their herds, their flocks, and all their other livestock.
units.rightText: And the cities shall they have to dwell in; and their suburbs shall be for their cattle, and for their substance, and for all their beasts.

units.leftText: The pasturelands around the cities you are to give the Levites will extend a thousand cubits from the wall on every side.
units.rightText: And the suburbs of the cities, which ye shall give unto the Levites, shall be from the wall of the city and outward a thousand cubits round about.
leftNotes: 35:4 1,000 cubits is approximately 1,500 feet or 457.2 meters.

units.leftText: You are also to measure two thousand cubits outside the city on the east, two thousand on the south, two thousand on the west, and two thousand on the north, with the city in the center. These areas will serve as larger pasturelands for the cities.
units.rightText: And ye shall measure without the city for the east side two thousand cubits, and for the south side two thousand cubits, and for the west side two thousand cubits, and for the north side two thousand cubits, the city being in the midst. This shall be to them the suburbs of the cities.
leftNotes: 35:5 2,000 cubits is approximately 3,000 feet or 914.4 meters.

units.leftText: Six of the cities you give the Levites are to be appointed as cities of refuge, to which a manslayer may flee. In addition to these, give the Levites forty-two other cities.
units.rightText: And the cities which ye shall give unto the Levites, they shall be the six cities of refuge, which ye shall give for the manslayer to flee unto: and besides them ye shall give forty and two cities.

units.leftText: The total number of cities you give the Levites will be forty-eight, with their corresponding pasturelands.
units.rightText: All the cities which ye shall give to the Levites shall be forty and eight cities; them shall ye give with their suburbs.

units.leftText: The cities that you apportion from the territory of the Israelites should be given to the Levites in proportion to the inheritance of each tribe: more from a larger tribe and less from a smaller one.” Six Cities of Refuge (Deuteronomy 4:41–43|DEU 4:41-43*; Deuteronomy 19:1–14|DEU 19:1-14*; Joshua 20:1–9|JOS 20:1-9*)
units.rightText: And concerning the cities which ye shall give of the possession of the children of Israel, from the many ye shall take many; and from the few ye shall take few: every one according to his inheritance which he inheriteth shall give of his cities unto the Levites.

units.leftText: Then the LORD said to Moses,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “Speak to the Israelites and tell them: When you cross the Jordan into the land of Canaan,
units.rightText: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye pass over the Jordan into the land of Canaan,

units.leftText: designate cities to serve as your cities of refuge, so that a person who kills someone unintentionally may flee there.
units.rightText: then ye shall appoint you cities to be cities of refuge for you, that the manslayer that killeth any person unwittingly may flee thither.

units.leftText: You are to have these cities as a refuge from the avenger, so that the manslayer will not die until he stands trial before the assembly.
units.rightText: And the cities shall be unto you for refuge from the avenger, that the manslayer die not, until he stand before the congregation for judgment.

units.leftText: The cities you select will be your six cities of refuge.
units.rightText: And the cities which ye shall give shall be for you six cities of refuge.

units.leftText: Select three cities across the Jordan and three in the land of Canaan as cities of refuge.
units.rightText: Ye shall give three cities beyond the Jordan, and three cities shall ye give in the land of Canaan; they shall be cities of refuge.

units.leftText: These six cities will serve as a refuge for the Israelites and for the foreigner or stranger among them, so that anyone who kills a person unintentionally may flee there.
units.rightText: For the children of Israel, and for the stranger and for the sojourner among them, shall these six cities be for refuge; that every one that killeth any person unwittingly may flee thither.

units.leftText: If, however, anyone strikes a person with an iron object and kills him, he is a murderer; the murderer must surely be put to death.
units.rightText: But if he smote him with an instrument of iron, so that he died, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.

units.leftText: Or if anyone has in his hand a stone of deadly size, and he strikes and kills another, he is a murderer; the murderer must surely be put to death.
units.rightText: And if he smote him with a stone in the hand, whereby a man may die, and he died, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.

units.leftText: If anyone has in his hand a deadly object of wood, and he strikes and kills another, he is a murderer; the murderer must surely be put to death.
units.rightText: Or if he smote him with a weapon of wood in the hand, whereby a man may die, and he died, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.

units.leftText: The avenger of blood is to put the murderer to death; when he finds him, he is to kill him.
units.rightText: The avenger of blood shall himself put the murderer to death: when he meeteth him, he shall put him to death.

units.leftText: Likewise, if anyone maliciously pushes another or intentionally throws an object at him and kills him,
units.rightText: And if he thrust him of hatred, or hurled at him, lying in wait, so that he died,

units.leftText: or if in hostility he strikes him with his hand and he dies, the one who struck him must surely be put to death; he is a murderer. When the avenger of blood finds the murderer, he is to kill him.
units.rightText: or in enmity smote him with his hand, so that he died; he that smote him shall surely be put to death; he is a murderer: the avenger of blood shall put the murderer to death, when he meeteth him.

units.leftText: But if anyone pushes a person suddenly, without hostility, or throws an object at him unintentionally,
units.rightText: But if he thrust him suddenly without enmity, or hurled upon him anything without lying in wait,

units.leftText: or without looking drops a heavy stone that kills him, but he was not an enemy and did not intend to harm him,
units.rightText: or with any stone, whereby a man may die, seeing him not, and cast it upon him, so that he died, and he was not his enemy, neither sought his harm;

units.leftText: then the congregation must judge between the slayer and the avenger of blood according to these ordinances.
units.rightText: then the congregation shall judge between the smiter and the avenger of blood according to these ordinances;

units.leftText: The assembly is to protect the manslayer from the hand of the avenger of blood. Then the assembly will return him to the city of refuge to which he fled, and he must live there until the death of the high priest, who was anointed with the holy oil.
units.rightText: and the congregation shall deliver the manslayer out of the hand of the avenger of blood, and the congregation shall restore him to his city of refuge, whither he was fled: and he shall dwell therein until the death of the high priest, who was anointed with the holy oil.

units.leftText: But if the manslayer ever goes outside the limits of the city of refuge to which he fled
units.rightText: But if the manslayer shall at any time go beyond the border of his city of refuge, whither he fleeth,

units.leftText: and the avenger of blood finds him outside of his city of refuge and kills him, then the avenger will not be guilty of bloodshed,
units.rightText: and the avenger of blood find him without the border of his city of refuge, and the avenger of blood slay the manslayer; he shall not be guilty of blood,

units.leftText: because the manslayer must remain in his city of refuge until the death of the high priest. Only after the death of the high priest may he return to the land he owns.
units.rightText: because he should have remained in his city of refuge until the death of the high priest: but after the death of the high priest the manslayer shall return into the land of his possession.

units.leftText: This will be a statutory ordinance for you for the generations to come, wherever you live.
units.rightText: And these things shall be for a statute and ordinance unto you throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

units.leftText: If anyone kills a person, the murderer is to be put to death on the testimony of the witnesses. But no one is to be put to death based on the testimony of a lone witness.
units.rightText: Whoso killeth any person, the murderer shall be slain at the mouth of witnesses: but one witness shall not testify against any person that he die.

units.leftText: You are not to accept a ransom for the life of a murderer who deserves to die; he must surely be put to death.
units.rightText: Moreover ye shall take no ransom for the life of a murderer, that is guilty of death; but he shall surely be put to death.

units.leftText: Nor should you accept a ransom for the person who flees to a city of refuge and allow him to return and live on his own land before the death of the high priest.
units.rightText: And ye shall take no ransom for him that is fled to his city of refuge, that he may come again to dwell in the land, until the death of the priest.

units.leftText: Do not pollute the land where you live, for bloodshed pollutes the land, and no atonement can be made for the land on which the blood is shed, except by the blood of the one who shed it.
units.rightText: So ye shall not pollute the land wherein ye are: for blood, it polluteth the land; and no expiation can be made for the land for the blood that is shed therein, but by the blood of him that shed it.

units.leftText: Do not defile the land where you live and where I dwell. For I, the LORD, dwell among the Israelites.”
units.rightText: And thou shalt not defile the land which ye inhabit, in the midst of which I dwell: for I, Jehovah, dwell in the midst of the children of Israel.

units.leftText: Now the family heads of the clan of Gilead son of Machir son of Manasseh, one of the clans of Joseph, approached Moses and the leaders who were the heads of the Israelite families and addressed them,
units.rightText: And the heads of the fathers’ houses of the family of the children of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came near, and spake before Moses, and before the princes, the heads of the fathers’ houses of the children of Israel:

units.leftText: saying, “When the LORD commanded my lord to give the land as an inheritance to the Israelites by lot, He also commanded him to give the inheritance of our brother Zelophehad to his daughters.
units.rightText: and they said, Jehovah commanded my lord to give the land for inheritance by lot to the children of Israel: and my lord was commanded by Jehovah to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother unto his daughters.

units.leftText: But if they marry any of the men from the other tribes of Israel, their inheritance will be withdrawn from the portion of our fathers and added to the tribe into which they marry. So our allotted inheritance would be taken away.
units.rightText: And if they be married to any of the sons of the other tribes of the children of Israel, then will their inheritance be taken away from the inheritance of our fathers, and will be added to the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they shall belong: so will it be taken away from the lot of our inheritance.

units.leftText: And when the Jubilee for the Israelites comes, their inheritance will be added to the tribe into which they marry and taken away from the tribe of our fathers.”
units.rightText: And when the jubilee of the children of Israel shall be, then will their inheritance be added unto the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they shall belong: so will their inheritance be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers.

units.leftText: So at the word of the LORD, Moses commanded the Israelites: “The tribe of the sons of Joseph speaks correctly.
units.rightText: And Moses commanded the children of Israel according to the word of Jehovah, saying, The tribe of the sons of Joseph speaketh right.

units.leftText: This is what the LORD has commanded concerning the daughters of Zelophehad: They may marry anyone they please, provided they marry within a clan of the tribe of their father.
units.rightText: This is the thing which Jehovah doth command concerning the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, Let them be married to whom they think best; only into the family of the tribe of their father shall they be married.

units.leftText: No inheritance in Israel may be transferred from tribe to tribe, because each of the Israelites is to retain the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.
units.rightText: So shall no inheritance of the children of Israel remove from tribe to tribe; for the children of Israel shall cleave every one to the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.

units.leftText: Every daughter who possesses an inheritance from any Israelite tribe must marry within a clan of the tribe of her father, so that every Israelite will possess the inheritance of his fathers.
units.rightText: And every daughter, that possesseth an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Israel, shall be wife unto one of the family of the tribe of her father, that the children of Israel may possess every man the inheritance of his fathers.

units.leftText: No inheritance may be transferred from one tribe to another, for each tribe of Israel must retain its inheritance.”
units.rightText: So shall no inheritance remove from one tribe to another tribe; for the tribes of the children of Israel shall cleave every one to his own inheritance.

units.leftText: So the daughters of Zelophehad did as the LORD had commanded Moses.
units.rightText: Even as Jehovah commanded Moses, so did the daughters of Zelophehad:

units.leftText: Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married to cousins on their father’s side.
units.rightText: for Mahlah, Tirzah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married unto their father’s brothers’ sons.

units.leftText: They married within the clans of the descendants of Manasseh son of Joseph, and their inheritance remained within the tribe of their father’s clan.
units.rightText: They were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph; and their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father.

units.leftText: These are the commandments and ordinances that the LORD gave the Israelites through Moses on the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho.
units.rightText: These are the commandments and the ordinances which Jehovah commanded by Moses unto the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.
